description:
All roads lead to fun with the Vortex F2 folding scooter. This kick scooter features a compact folding frame, Max Grip deck and brake, durable bike-style grips, and quick-release adjustable height complete with three lock-in pins. Experience the fun, convenience, and performance of the Vortex F2!
Kick scooter with easy folding design for compact storage and transportation.
Full coverage MaxGrip™ deck and brake provides non-slip contact.
Quick-release adjustable height with three lock-in points can fit a wide range of riders.
Durable bike-style grips offer comfortable handling.
Kickstand lets you park the scooter upright, protecting the grips and frame from damage.
100 mm wheels with ABEC – 7 bearings. Heavy duty frame supports up to 176 lbs.
